text: I am wrapped in a sense of anticipation, caught between two worlds—the ordered, brightly-lit space of the meeting room behind glass, and the vibrant display of ideas and invention before me labeled R+D. One space invites human gathering and discourse, the other entices with knowledge and possibility. Here, I am both observer and participant, aware of the delicate boundary between creation and contemplation. I feel a subtle excitement for learning, tempered by a wish to connect with others who share this curiosity.
